title: Rust DIO serializer cannot preserve an explicit advertised SCHC version
description: Final Rule/version correctness review: rust/lichen-rpl/src/message.rs Dio has no option/version-policy field and write_to unconditionally emits SchcRuleVersionOption::current(). It cannot serialize or round-trip an explicit one-byte legacy/mismatched advertised version, diverging from the normative zero-or-one option semantics and Python. Add an explicit canonical DIO option/version input, insert current only when absent, preserve one supplied byte, and reject malformed or duplicate options. Cover root/non-root current insertion, explicit v2, malformed, duplicate, and round-trip behavior.
